description: Leartech preset for Go services. Layer on top of default.json — adds groups for the leartech-go-runtime base image and internal Go libraries.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge leartech-go-runtime image bumps as soon as they land. 'at any time' overrides default Monday-only schedule — internal lib, low risk, but consumers can be blocked on it (e.g. fleet Go-1.26 bump 2026-05-07).

Auto-merge leartech-{go,bus}-common + generated leartech-{go,bus}-packages/* as soon as they land. 'at any time' overrides default Monday-only schedule because internal libs may need to flow within hours.
